d: Delhi is choking again as air pollution levels surge ahead of Diwali, with the Air Quality Index (AQI) crossing 400 in several areas. But this is not just another seasonal pollution spike. Experts warn that prolonged exposure to toxic air can affect multiple organs, including the brain, and may even contribute to neurodegeneration. As winter approaches, changing wind patterns are expected to trap pollutants over the capital, worsening an already alarming situation.
